about: The techniques tsrs (oxc-project/tsrs, Apache-2.0, a Rust port of the same compiler) has over tsgo, as candidates for tsc-ts. Paths under "tsrs" are relative to a tsrs checkout. scripts/tsc_ts_delta.py reads and writes this file; README.md here is the procedure.

deltas.title: Two enum members of different values answered before the rules for simple types
deltas.exactness: Both flag words are exactly NumberLiteral|EnumLiteral (or StringLiteral|EnumLiteral): the one rule that relates two enum members asks for equal values, every other rule needs a flag neither has. Pure early return.

deltas.title: The type of a reference at a flow node kept across walks, by (flow node, reference key)

tsrs.measured: webpack -5.0%, vscode -2.2% (whole process); no Compiler number

deltas.exactness: The seven conditions of flow-memo.md:29-64 (nothing transient, nothing specific to the reference node, the same instantiation counters, no new identities, the same caches, the depth limit, faithful shared flows); a shadow mode that walks every hit again found two of them.
deltas.note: tsc-ts keeps one walk per reference key (FlowWalk, upstream 5dc9acc): the delta is the table by flow node with checkpoints every fourth node.

deltas.title: A union of kinds that are never undefined or null answers the nullability facts with one bit
deltas.exactness: The bit is set where the union is built from its final sorted list; the shortcut fires only when the caller needs no object fact, and the walk it skips resolves nothing.

deltas.title: A filter over the member names of Function, CallableFunction, NewableFunction and Object skips the fallback lookups of a property miss

tsrs.measured: vscode -0.99%, supabase -11.92%, cal-diy -4.29%; no Compiler number

deltas.exactness: Built once the four global types have resolved members, dropped where base types are reset; a rejected name is a key of none of the four tables, and the skipped steps have no side effects for a type with resolved members.

deltas.title: Symbol tables with a filter and fingerprints in front of the key comparison, equal strings decided by identity first

deltas.exactness: A lookup structure only: the same symbols in the same order.
deltas.note: Probe first: tsc-ts tables are Maps keyed by strings whose hashes garnet caches.
